jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

At AirPay, we are on a mission to improve the consumer experience for dental patients. We are growing rapidly, partnering with top dental provider groups and insurance carriers. Our company is backed by top tier VC’s led by IA Ventures along with the founders of Flatiron Health, Clover Health, Shutterstock and more. We are committed to delivering exceptional customer service and building lasting relationships with our users. We’re looking for a dynamic and motivated Customer Success Manager to join our team and help us maintain our high standards of customer care.

About The Role

As a Customer Success Manager, you will be responsible for owning the end-to-end experience for a set of dental practices using AirPay software. You will guide clients through the implementation of our technology, ensuring that their needs are met from initial setup to successful adoption, and continue to manage the relationship post-launch. Your goal is to ensure customers derive maximum value from our solutions, which will result in high satisfaction, retention, and growth opportunities. This is an in-person role based out of our New York City office, with flexibility for some remote work. Note: We are hiring this role across levels (Associate/Manager/Senior Manager).

Key Responsibilities

Act as the primary point of contact for assigned customers during & after implementation, ensuring ongoing success and engagement with the product
Lead the implementation process for a portfolio of strategic customers, tailoring the plan to meet each customer’s needs
Define project timelines, milestones, and deliverables, and manage customer & internal expectations throughout the process leading to an on-time & high-quality deployment of AirPay
Provide workflow guidance and customized training & best practices to ensure users are fully equipped to use the product
Drive customer adoption and maximize product usage, ensuring customers achieve their desired outcomes
Build and nurture strong, long-lasting relationships across stakeholders - users, leadership - within the dental practice and/or Dental Service Organizations (DSOs)
Conduct regular check-ins, business reviews, and account health assessments to proactively address challenges, maximize customer value with the product, and identify opportunities for growth

Requirements

Skills & Qualifications

5+ years of experience in consulting, client services, or customer success. Prior experience within tech or in implementing software solutions is a strong plus.
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities
Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple customers and projects simultaneously, ensuring deadlines and milestones are met.
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders, ensuring customer satisfaction and loyalty.
Adaptability and self-motivation; desire to work in a startup environment where roles may shift and we may encounter new and unfamiliar situations
Strong work ethic. We are committed to excellence, so we work harder and smarter.
Believes that work should be enjoyable. We are a close-knit team and care about having fun at work — we want you to feel the same.
Mission-oriented with an interest in healthcare & fintech, and eager to be part of solving America’s healthcare crisis
Based in NYC or willing to relocate, and able to work in the office at least 3 days a week.
Please note that you must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. for this position.

Compensation

$100k – $145k + equity

jobs.title: Customer Success Specialist, Entry Level
jobs.description:
Jobright is a personal AI job search agent that simplifies the job search process and helps users reach better job outcomes. The Customer Success Specialist helps customers adopt the product and realize value through onboarding, education, issue resolution, customer communication, risk escalation, and cross-functional feedback sharing.

Why Join Us

• Build real, production AI agents used by real users
• High ownership and impact
• Work at the intersection of AI, agents, and product
• Shape how people experience AI-driven job search

Responsibilities

• Guide new customers through onboarding and product setup
• Respond to customer questions with clear, timely, and helpful communication
• Educate customers on product features, workflows, and best practices
• Track customer goals, adoption signals, issues, and follow-up actions
• Identify risks and escalate technical or account concerns to the right teams
• Capture customer feedback and partner with product, support, and sales teams
Qualification

Required

• Strong written and verbal communication with a customer-first mindset
• Excellent organization, follow-through, and problem-solving skills
• Ability to explain product concepts clearly to different audiences
• Comfort learning software tools and managing multiple customer conversations
• Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively in a remote environment

Preferred

• Internship, part-time, volunteer, or project experience in customer success, support, account management, or hospitality
• Familiarity with CRM, help-desk, project management, or collaboration tools
• Experience supporting a SaaS, technology, education, or recruiting product
• Basic ability to analyze customer usage data and identify trends

jobs.title: Compliance Analyst, Entry Level
jobs.description:
Jobright is a personal AI job search agent that simplifies the job search process and helps users reach better job outcomes. The Compliance Analyst supports policy adherence and regulatory compliance through research, control and process reviews, monitoring, audit support, remediation tracking, documentation, and stakeholder reporting.

Why Join Us

• Build real, production AI agents used by real users
• High ownership and impact
• Work at the intersection of AI, agents, and product
• Shape how people experience AI-driven job search

Responsibilities

• Review processes and records for alignment with policies and requirements
• Research regulatory and industry requirements and summarize their impact
• Collect evidence, maintain compliance trackers, and document review results
• Support monitoring activities, audits, and issue remediation
• Prepare clear reports, metrics, and status updates for stakeholders
• Coordinate with legal, security, operations, and product teams on compliance tasks
Qualification

Required

• Strong attention to detail, research ability, and written communication
• Ability to interpret policies and apply requirements consistently
• Comfort working with spreadsheets, documentation, and structured review workflows
• Sound judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information
• Ability to organize multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a remote environment

Preferred

• Coursework, internship, certification, or project experience in compliance, audit, legal, privacy, or security
• Exposure to privacy, consumer protection, employment, financial, or technology compliance
• Familiarity with GRC, ticketing, case management, or document management tools
• Experience supporting an audit, policy review, or control assessment
